body:
Part of #98.

## Why

The manual step is the whole complaint: today you `hkb init` a repo, start its dispatcher, and the
board is still invisible to `hkb serve` until a human hand-edits `~/.config/hkb/boards.json`.

## What

At the end of a successful `hkb init`, register the checkout that was just set up by calling
`registerUserBoard(root, board)` from `src/board.js`.

- **Idempotent** — the helper already handles it; a second `hkb init` in the same checkout must not
  add a second entry.
- **Never silent.** Print one line saying what happened and where, e.g.
  `registered this checkout in ~/.config/hkb/boards.json — hkb serve will show it` or
  `already listed in ~/.config/hkb/boards.json`. This line is the disclosure that init wrote a file
  outside the repo, so it is not optional.
- **Works offline.** `hkb init --no-labels --repo owner/name` writes every local file and sends
  nothing; registration is a local write, so it must still happen on that path.
- **Not fatal.** If the list cannot be written (unwritable config dir, malformed existing file), say
  so and carry on — a failed registration must never fail an otherwise good `hkb init`.
- `--json` gains a stable field: `registered: { file, added }`.

There is deliberately **no `--no-register` flag**. The default path asks nothing of the human, and the
printed line is how they find out.

## Done when

`npm run lint && npm test` is green and `test/init.test.js` covers, under a temp `KB_CONFIG_HOME`:

- a fresh `hkb init` adds exactly one entry pointing at the new checkout;
- a second `hkb init` in the same checkout leaves the list unchanged and says "already listed";
- the offline `--no-labels --repo owner/name` path still registers;
- an unwritable/malformed list produces a warning and exit 0, not a failed init;
- the human line and the `--json` `registered` field are both asserted.

## Contract

- Call `registerUserBoard(root, board = null, file = userBoardsFile())` from `src/board.js` and use its
  `{ added, file, entries }` result — do not re-implement merging or writing in `src/init.js`.
- The `--json` field is exactly `registered: { file, added }`.
- Touch only `src/init.js` and `test/init.test.js`. The registry itself and `src/serve.js` belong to
  siblings; changing them here will collide.
goal: hkb init in a new checkout makes it appear on hkb serve with no hand-edited config
title: hkb init registers the checkout it just set up
